item: Row 398: the corpus-wide Who list and the map's Places say when they were cut
summary: Anti-capping, the family of rows 395 and 397. who_aggregate and where_aggregate cut at limit and returned count=len(rows), so Insights > Who guessed a cut from shown >= cap: a corpus of 3,000 people read '200 found' (the cap) and a list of exactly 200 claimed a cut it did not have. Both now count every group the same filters and min_articles threshold keep (total, truncated; additive keys); the Who head says the real total and shows 'Showing the first N.' only when the server says the list was cut, an older payload keeps the guess. The map's Places lens fetched where?limit=400 with no note, and the limit ran before the mappable filter, so unlocated places took slots and the map drew fewer points while more drawable places existed; where_aggregate gains placed_only (the lat/lon filter before the limit, default off, cache key unchanged when off), the map asks for it and says '{shown} of {total} shown.' (existing x12 key) when cut. No new strings.
